summary: Mostly no. On 1h, a fresh Strong Buy did no better than random entries, and neither did staying long or short while the rating read Buy or Sell. The result that holds up is a fresh Strong Buy on 4h: price beat random entries by 1.37% after 20 candles, carried by downtrends and by SOL.

verdicts.use: Staying short while the rating reads Sell or Strong Sell
verdicts.text: No better than random entries on 1h. On 4h the result rests on the drop between Apr 4 and Jun 22, 2022, and on daily it beat random by 5.63% only in uptrends.

notes: On 4h, a fresh Strong Buy gave 394 entries in 272 separate moves. Twenty candles later, price was 1.37% ahead of random entries, and the luck band topped out at 0.8%. The result holds without its strongest stretch and at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. On 1h the same signal gave 1,851 entries and landed inside the band.

The 4h result does not hold in every market. With the pair below its 200-day SMA, price after a fresh Strong Buy beat random entries by 2.26% and held at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. Above the SMA the gap was 0.55%, inside the luck band. Only SOL cleared its band on its own, at 2.66%, while BTC and ETH showed nothing.

Staying long on every Strong Buy candle beat random entries by 0.14% on 1h and 0.68% on 4h, at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. Split by trend, neither side holds alone. On 1h the uptrend result depends on the stretch between Dec 25, 2020 and Jan 10, 2021. On 4h the downtrend result depends on the stretch between Jan 3 and Feb 4, 2023, and BTC and ETH each stayed inside their bands.

Buy or Strong Buy, the featured long setting, enters about three times as often as Strong Buy alone on 1h. Adding the plain Buy readings pulled the 1h result down to 0.03%, inside the luck band. On 4h it beat random entries by 0.3%, but only because of the run between Dec 25, 2020 and May 21, 2021. Without that run the result is chance.

A fresh Buy on daily went the wrong way. Twenty days later, price was 2.83% behind random entries, and the gap holds without its strongest stretch. In uptrends it grew to 5.85% and showed at 10, 20, 50 and 100 days. In downtrends it was 1.87%, inside the band, and on 1h and 4h a fresh Buy showed nothing.

For a long DCA bot, a fresh Strong Buy on 4h is the reading worth testing as a filter beside your other start conditions. Its gap held out to 100 candles, so it fits a take profit that waits for a longer move rather than a quick one. A fresh Buy on daily is a reason to leave that reading out of a long bot in uptrends. On the short side, a fresh Strong Sell on 1h faded by 100 candles, so it suits a short take profit, not a long hold.
